caveats: All figures are conditional worst-case sufficient bounds under independent-family sampling and range-2 ([-1,1]) concentration assumptions.
These are NOT approved sample sizes, NOT achieved power, NOT spending recommendations.
6 convenience families and 28 template clones do NOT establish independent sampling.
No ICC, variance pilot, or actual provider cost has been measured.
Bonferroni correction for m=12 is correctly applied; contrasts need not be independent for Bonferroni validity, but family-level concentration still requires independent units.
Any cheaper variance-based plan needs an independent prospective pilot, justified ICC/dependence model, and separately checked simulation — all currently UNKNOWN.

family_unit_crisis.issue: The independent sampling unit is the family, not the trial. Families generated from the same template, author, or causal structure are correlated and cannot be treated as independent draws.
family_unit_crisis.evidence: 6 original convenience families + 28 template-clone surface contexts
family_unit_crisis.consequence: Population inference remains HOLD. Current intervals are descriptive only.

strata_order_balance.r2_pooled_note: R2 pooled order counts (1440:432) include fixed-ABC ancillary phases; the R3 primary design already has all six orders at 432 each. R3 does not reinterpret pooled counts as an imbalanced primary experiment.
strata_order_balance.r3_primary_order_balance: all six arm-order permutations 524 each (9432 trials / 3144 matched blocks)

per_provider_cost.reason: No live provider call has been made. No price/quota/cost data exists.
per_provider_cost.requirement: A separate provider-adapter commission must measure and report actual costs under an issued grant before any spending decision.

stopping_and_power_requirements: Fix n and stopping rules before unblinding.
A blinded independent pilot may inform variance/cost and predeclared sample-size re-estimation; it cannot be pooled into a held-out confirmatory bank.
No outcome-dependent retries, response shopping, or exclusions.
Planned missing/denied/malformed/unscorable outcomes remain in the denominator.

proposed_economical_pilot.description: A bounded pilot with ~50 independently sourced families could provide an ICC/variance estimate for a more realistic sample-size calculation. This is a PROPOSAL requiring owner consent, not an approved design.

model_use_grant_frontier.note: Mere nonempty strings are insufficient. The competent issuer must actually authorize exact purpose, packet disclosure, retention, maximum attempts/retries and cost under a current pin/expiry/revocation policy.
